Serving your suburb

Terraces and Conversions, Kept Watertight

The Inner West is wall-to-wall Victorian and Federation terraces, semis and warehouse conversions, and most of their bathrooms were added or renovated decades ago over old timber floors. When that aged waterproofing finally lets go, the water has nowhere to go but down — onto the ceiling of the living room below, or through the shared wall of the semi or unit next door. Before you call, why is my shower leaking? explains the causes that apply to older homes.

The repair is made from the surface, which is what a period bathroom needs. We reseal your shower, regrout joints that an old timber floor has cracked and renew the membrane only where it has failed, so original tiling is not lifted to chase a leak. Our vans reach the Inner West and all Sydney areas we service, and we inspect at your door.

Marrickville Leichhardt Balmain Newtown All 33 Sydney LGAs
Why Inner West locals call us

Why Aged Waterproofing Fails in Period Homes

Period homes need a lighter touch

These period homes are exactly where a surface repair earns its keep. Heritage controls and strata by-laws often rule out a full strip-out, and nobody wants to lose original tiles or a renovated bathroom to chase one leak. We reseal, regrout and re-waterproof directly — from a single Newtown terrace to a converted warehouse block in Marrickville. For a period home, that is what professional shower leak repairs should look like.

  • Two-storey terraces where the leak shows downstairs
  • Heritage bathrooms over old timber floors
  • Warehouse-conversion and semi ensuites

We come to the terrace and quote on site

There is no showroom — a leak specialist comes to your terrace, semi or unit, traces where the water is really escaping and gives you a fixed-scope quote in writing up front. Most Inner West inspections are booked within the same week.

  • Inspection at your terrace, semi or unit
  • A fixed scope in writing up front
  • Certificate of waterproofing on completion
The signs to watch for

What a Leaking Shower Looks Like in a Terrace

In a Victorian or Federation terrace the leak usually shows up a room or a floor away from the shower, because the water runs along old timber joists before it appears. These are the signs Inner West owners call us about.

A stain on the ceiling below

In a two-storey terrace the first sign is almost always a damp patch on the ceiling of the room beneath the bathroom.

Springy or lifting floor tiles

Movement in an old timber floor cracks grout and lifts tiles, opening a path for water under the bed.

Silicone gone in a converted ensuite

Warehouse and semi conversions often have ensuites added over the years; their screen silicone is usually the first thing to perish.

Grout that never dries

Dark, permanently damp grout in a heritage bathroom means the original waterproofing is no longer holding water back.

A musty smell in a closed bathroom

Terrace bathrooms are often small and poorly ventilated, so trapped moisture behind the tiles smells musty long before it shows.

Salt and paint damage on old walls

Efflorescence and blistered paint on a party wall point to water tracking through the wet area into the brickwork.

The right repair for the real cause

Choosing the Right Repair for an Older Bathroom

Older Inner West bathrooms rarely need everything done at once. We find the leak path on site and use the lightest fix that will actually stop it, keeping the original tiling wherever we can.

Resealing

Perished silicone at the screen and wall junctions is cut out and replaced — the most common fix in a terrace ensuite and often all it needs.

Regrouting

Cracked grout over a moving timber floor is raked out and replaced; where leaks persist we epoxy-regrout the wet zone so water cannot track behind heritage tiles.

Re-waterproofing

When the decades-old membrane under a period bathroom has failed, we lay a fresh liquid membrane over the wet area without tearing out the original tiling.

Base and junction repairs

Leaks at the base, waste and floor-to-wall junctions — common where an old timber floor has moved — are sealed at the source.

Repair or replace

A Repair Keeps the Original Bathroom Intact

In a heritage terrace a repair is almost always the right call: it stops the leak, keeps the original tiling, and avoids the cost and disruption of a full rebuild. We only recommend replacing when the substrate itself has gone.

Surface repairFull rebuild
What happens to your tilesThey stay exactly where they areRemoved, then replaced
Time on siteUsually a single dayOne to three weeks
Shower back in useAbout 24 hoursAfter the full rebuild
Mess and disruptionMinimal, no skip binDemolition, dust and a skip
Waterproofing certificateSuppliedSupplied
Typical costA fraction of a rebuildFull bathroom renovation cost

A guide to the differences, not a quote — we confirm the right approach after the on-site inspection.

What it costs

What Drives an Inner West Repair Cost

A repair costs a fraction of rebuilding a period bathroom, and you get a fixed-scope quote on site first. What the repair involves is what moves the price:

  • Whether it is a reseal or a full re-waterproof of an aged wet area
  • How much the old timber floor has moved and cracked the bed
  • Heritage tile and grout types, and matching them where visible
  • Access in a narrow terrace and the age of the bathroom

For an Inner West home the quote is fixed in writing once we have inspected on site.

Inner West Shower Repair Questions

My place is a heritage terrace — can you fix the shower without disturbing the original tiles?
Usually, yes. We treat the silicone, grout, membrane or base from the surface, so original and heritage tiles stay in place.
The leak is coming through to the room below or the neighbour’s wall — is that common here?
Very. In terraces, semis and conversions the bathroom usually sits over a living room or against a shared wall, so a failed seal shows up downstairs or next door.
Do you cover all of the Inner West?
Yes — Newtown, Marrickville, Leichhardt, Balmain and the surrounding suburbs. We come to you.
How quickly can you get to a leak in the Inner West?
Inspections across the Inner West can usually be booked within the same week. If water is already coming through a ceiling or a party wall, tell us when you call and we will prioritise it.
What does it cost to repair a leaking shower in an Inner West terrace?
The price follows the scope: a reseal costs less than re-waterproofing an aged wet area, and old timber floors or heritage tiles can add work. We inspect on site and give you a fixed-scope quote in writing first.
Do you work in Inner West strata and converted apartment buildings?
Yes. We repair strata and body corporate bathrooms across the Inner West, and where we re-waterproof we supply a certificate on completion for the strata records.

  • Whether it is a reseal or a full re-waterproof of an aged wet area
  • How much the old timber floor has moved and cracked the bed
  • Heritage tile and grout types, and matching them where visible
  • Access in a narrow terrace and the age of the bathroom

For an Inner West home the quote is fixed in writing once we have inspected on site.

Inner West

Inner West Shower Repair Questions

My place is a heritage terrace — can you fix the shower without disturbing the original tiles?
Usually, yes. We treat the silicone, grout, membrane or base from the surface, so original and heritage tiles stay in place.
The leak is coming through to the room below or the neighbour’s wall — is that common here?
Very. In terraces, semis and conversions the bathroom usually sits over a living room or against a shared wall, so a failed seal shows up downstairs or next door.
Do you cover all of the Inner West?
Yes — Newtown, Marrickville, Leichhardt, Balmain and the surrounding suburbs. We come to you.
How quickly can you get to a leak in the Inner West?
Inspections across the Inner West can usually be booked within the same week. If water is already coming through a ceiling or a party wall, tell us when you call and we will prioritise it.
What does it cost to repair a leaking shower in an Inner West terrace?
The price follows the scope: a reseal costs less than re-waterproofing an aged wet area, and old timber floors or heritage tiles can add work. We inspect on site and give you a fixed-scope quote in writing first.
Do you work in Inner West strata and converted apartment buildings?
Yes. We repair strata and body corporate bathrooms across the Inner West, and where we re-waterproof we supply a certificate on completion for the strata records.
